meta: Tailors use AI to turn customers' vague descriptions into clear notes, complete measurement sheets and easy-to-read quotes.

muc.title: Vague style descriptions
muc.text: Customers ordering clothes often describe the style very vaguely. AI helps tailors turn that into clear notes.

muc.title: A measurement sheet
muc.text: Ask AI for a measurement sheet for an áo dài, shirt or dress, with boxes for chest, waist, hips and sleeve length, so nothing is missed.

muc.title: Describe the style
muc.text: Write down what the customer says and ask AI to rewrite it as collar, sleeves, length and fabric, plus questions to check with the customer.

muc.title: A clear quote
muc.text: Give AI the fabric price, labor, extras and pickup date, ask for an easy-to-read quote, then check every number yourself.

muc.title: An áo dài measurement sheet
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to make an áo dài measurement sheet with a space for the pickup date, then save it for your next customer.
